description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Atanikitha, Imaduwa D/S Division, Galle District (25/0184)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters, including declarations of title determination for specific land parcels, ownership details, and land registration under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed schedules listing land parcel numbers, owners, extents, and encumbrances, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
